author: derekkchen
caption: Smash Burger Ingredients * Onion(thinly sliced) * 75/25 or 80/20 ground beef * Salt and pepper * American Cheese * Brioche Buns * Pickles Sauce * 3/4 cup mayonnaise * 1/3 cup ketchup * 1/4 tbsp mustard * 1/2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce * 1/2 tbsp pickle juice * 1/2 tsp smoked paprika * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/2 tsp onion powder Instructions 1. Thinly slice onion using a mandolin or a knife. 2. Form ground beef into 4oz balls. 3. Combine burger sauce ingredients. 4. Heat cast iron/stainless steel pan on medium high heat for 2-3 minutes. It’s hot when water beads up. 5. Place balls on pan and season with salt and pepper. 6. Add a small handful of onions on top and smash down as hard as you can to make a thin patty. 7. Cook for two minutes, scrape and flip over. 8. Add cheese and buns(top bun first then bottom bun). 9. Once the cheese is melted(1-2 minutes), assemble burger with pickles and sauce. #30minutemeals #burger #smashburger #cheeseburger #burgers #cheeseburgers #smashburgers #recipe #cooking #food #recipevideo #cookingvideo #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easyrecipeideas #quickrecipes #quickrecipe #foodie #foodvideo #fastmeals #quickrecipeideas
